svg.title: UAVCount: Waterside Video Detection and Counting
svg.desc: Four illustrated stages: camera-motion alignment, candidate verification, measured track recovery, and three-frame confirmation of new arrivals. Ten warm-up frames precede decisions at zero-based end frames 12, 15, 18 and 21. Engineering regression results are for semi-synthetic data.
svg.text: Recheck weak detections; recover measured tracks.
Confirm a new spot across three recent frames.
Engineering regression on 156 semi-synthetic clips · Frames shown schematically
